name: vaultvest-app
description: Frontend and supporting services for VaultVest — a governance-gated token vesting dApp on Stellar. Consumes the deployed vaultvest-contract via Soroban RPC.
comment:overrides: Pins for transitive dependencies whose parents (next, autoprefixer, tailwindcss, eslint) still request advisory-affected versions. Both pins are semver-compatible with what those parents ask for, so they are drop-in. Both advisories are build-time only and are not reachable from the deployed app -- see SECURITY.md 'Known Limitations'. Drop these once the parents ship patched versions of their own.
